def: properly, to live; by implication (intensively) to declare or show

words.word: to me i also will shew

occurrences.text: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
words: to me I also will shew

occurrences.text: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God’s behalf.
Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
